classification.difficultyReason: Read four pairs of negative counters as the product, then cancel opposite units against the three positive counters.

content.prompt: Use the counters to work out $3+4\times(-2)$

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2 counter figure beneath the instruction
spec.description: Three positive unit counters in a horizontal row on the left; eight negative unit counters on the right in two rows of four, forming four vertical pairs.
spec.mathematics: Three positive units plus four groups of two negative units.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied signed unit counters are visible; no cancellations or final result appear in the question figure.

answer.worked:
Four pairs give eight negative counters. Cancel three positive–negative pairs; five negative counters remain.
$$\begin{align*}3+4\times(-2)&=3+(-8)\\&=-5\end{align*}$$
